ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious WSMAN Provider Image Loads
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects signs of potential use of the WSMAN provider from uncommon processes locally and remote execution. Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: (((ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\WsmSvc\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\WsmAuto\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\Microsoft\\\.WSMan\\\.Management\\\.ni\\\.dll$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "WsmSvc\.dll" OR process_original_file_name = "WSMANAUTOMATION\.DLL" OR process_original_file_name = "Microsoft\.WSMan\.Management\.dll")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\svchost\\\.exe$") AND process_original_file_name = "WsmWmiPl\.dll")) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\sdiagnhost\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\services\\\.exe$")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*svchost\\\.exe\\ \\-k\\ netsvcs\\ \\-p\\ \\-s\\ BITS.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*svchost\\\.exe\\ \\-k\\ GraphicsPerfSvcGroup\\ \\-s\\ GraphicsPerfSvc.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*svchost\\\.exe\\ \\-k\\ NetworkService\\ \\-p\\ \\-s\\ Wecsvc.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*svchost\\\.exe\\ \\-k\\ netsvcs.*")) OR ((process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Microsoft\\\.NET\\\\Framework64\\\\v") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Microsoft\\\.NET\\\\Framework\\\\v") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Microsoft\\\.NET\\\\FrameworkArm\\\\v") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Microsoft\\\.NET\\\\FrameworkArm64\\\\v")) AND process_path = RGX("\\\\mscorsvw\\\.exe$")) OR (process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\Configure\-SMRemoting\.exe" OR process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\ServerManager\.exe") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\asgard2\\-agent\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Citrix\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\_ise\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\\\$WINDOWS\\\.\\~BT\\\\Sources\\\\")) AND  NOT (process_path = RGX("\\\\svchost\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = "None")
